info.title: Elora CAD Library agent API
info.description: Registered free website/API/MCP delivery: up to 60 individual files/formats per personal 24-hour window starting with first admission, subject to 1 GiB hosted bytes per UTC day, shared 10 GiB/UTC day or lower global ceiling, and service limits; delivery may stop earlier. Anonymous trial: 50 public files/512 MiB per UTC day. Website email registration is reusable. Exclusive conversions require a verified account. Existing server-verified active paid plans: 10,000 files per UTC calendar month, not unlimited. No new plan, price or charge. The stated numerical free allowance is 10 times TraceParts Free six CAD models/24h; files and models differ and no blanket superiority is implied. See the sourced qualified comparison extension.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse for the same artifact for up to five minutes. Conflicting/expired keys return 409. Retries recheck publication and do not double-reserve quotas. Without a key, identical requests deduplicate within a five-minute bucket.

X-CAD-Allowance-Tier.description: Server-resolved anonymous, registered or paid tier.

X-CAD-Files-Limit.description: File count limit for the current tier and file period.

X-CAD-Files-Remaining.description: Admitted files remaining in the current file period. Each file/format counts separately.

X-CAD-Bytes-Limit.description: Hosted byte reservation budget; independent of the file-count period.

X-CAD-Bytes-Remaining.description: Hosted byte reservations remaining before the UTC daily reset. Shared capacity can impose a lower effective budget.

X-CAD-Allowance-Reset.description: Seconds until the controlling file allowance reset: personal first-admission 24-hour window for registered free, UTC calendar month for paid, UTC day for anonymous.

X-CAD-Bytes-Reset.description: Seconds until the independent byte budget resets at 00:00 UTC.

X-CAD-File-Period.description: day, 24_hours_from_first_admission, or calendar_month, according to the server-resolved tier.

401.description: Anonymous trial exhausted: register once. Exclusive conversions always require verified account/OAuth.

429.description: Registered free 60-file personal 24-hour allowance, paid 10,000-file UTC calendar month, UTC daily byte budget, or shared delivery capacity exhausted. Honour Retry-After; a paid plan cannot bypass shared capacity. Free users may wait for their reset or use a server-verified existing paid plan at the account billing settings. No automatic charge.

registered_free_comparison.description: Sourced numerical registered-free allowance comparison with distinct units and material qualifications.

files_reset_at.description: Exact reset controlling the next file admission; null before an unused personal window starts. The 10,000-file account monthly ceiling can override the personal-window reset.

RegistrationBearer.description: Optional scoped public-download credential. Create a revocable agent token from Connect an API client after browser registration. Tokens expire with the registration (up to 30 days); use Authorization only. Legacy registration bearer credentials remain accepted. No exclusive or paid access.

x-elora-download-policy.counting_unit: individual admitted file/format link requests and official-source redirects, including technical documentation; not confirmed completed downloads

comparison.qualification: Numerical registered-free allowance only, not equivalent products, catalogue coverage, format availability, quality, API access or overall superiority. Both periods begin at the first download/admission. Elora byte/global safeguards can stop delivery earlier. TraceParts still allows technical documentation after its CAD-model limit and has a paid unlimited-download plan.

x-elora-download-policy.global_budget_unit: reserved bytes for admitted hosted links, not a hard provider transfer/billing limit
x-elora-download-policy.plan_transitions: Earlier free and paid admissions count toward the paid account monthly ceiling; downgrades or free credentials cannot reset it.
